All three have accepted the revised plan, so it now starts. A and C each get a first turn in the next few weeks before either gets another. A and C will set exact dates, duration, and pickup and return times before pickup. B will confirm the pickup and return windows.

The trailer stays on B's pad under the current arrangement through both first turns. B will ask the landlord before any change to what is kept there. The three of them will review storage seven days after both first turns end. If they cannot agree by then, no additional turns start until they do.

I kept a brief numbered list of all concerns and showed the current list when it changed. I corrected my earlier note about A's acceptance: A accepted the revised plan. I made no legal decisions and moved no money.
